page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-32 is a virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 architecture, powered by an AMD EPYC 9J45 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. This flexible profile is provisioned with 2 physical cores and 2 threads per core, yielding 4 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is sized at 32.0 GB, establishing a generous memory-to-core allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware accelerators are absent, with a GPU count of zero. The instance includes no onboard local storage, requiring the attachment of remote block volumes for persistent disk storage and OS file systems. In terms of base networking resources, the instance comes provisioned with 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. Resource efficiency is characterized by high memory density on a low core footprint, avoiding the costs associated with provisioning unneeded compute capacity simply to acquire adequate RAM.

VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-32 is aligned with workloads that demand significant memory residency relative to computational throughput. Best-fit use cases include in-memory key-value stores and caching tiers, small to mid-sized relational database management systems, memory-bound ETL batch processing, and containerized backend services.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-32 is an x86_64 compute instance driven by a 2.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9J45 processor. Configured with 2 physical cores and 4 dedicated vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of memory, it provides an elevated memory allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage architectures for persistence, while providing 1 complimentary public IPv4 address. By delivering a substantial RAM footprint without necessitating higher core counts, it provides favorable cost efficiency for memory-centric software architectures. The instance is well matched for in-memory data caching, transactional databases, data transformation pipelines, and memory-heavy microservices.
